answer.text: Selling losing positions to realise losses (tax-loss harvesting) and use inflows

explanation.text: The Logic: Tax-loss harvesting realises losses to offset capital gains; inflow-based rebalancing defers gains. Combined strategies minimise tax drag. The Trap: Selling only winners triggers gains. Cross-Exam Context: Topic 10 cross-ref. Manager's Pro-Tip: Wash-sale rules (Indian context: Section 94(7)) limit immediate repurchase — plan gaps carefully.
